_README: TEMPLATE. Copy to spikes/evidence/<scenario_id>-<device_id>.json, set scenario_id, fill every field from a PHYSICAL device run, delete all keys starting with underscore. Unfilled (null) fields are INVALID and the scenario stays PENDING. Never set synthetic=true for real evidence; synthetic and emulator/simulator files never count.

REM-WIN-00.title: Installed Windows build shows correct app identity for an immediate toast
REM-WIN-00.pass_criteria: Docs say the plugin shows PowerShell name and icon in development and only works for installed apps.

REM-WIN-01.title: Plugin schedule on desktop is immediate, not scheduled
REM-WIN-01.pass_criteria: Confirms the app must not route desktop reminders through the plugin schedule option.

REM-WIN-02.title: Native scheduled toast with the app process not running
REM-WIN-02.pass_criteria: At least 19 of 20 trials within 5 minutes with the app process confirmed not running at fire time. Record whether the app has package identity.

REM-WIN-03.title: Computer off or asleep beyond the 5-minute window
REM-WIN-03.pass_criteria: Microsoft docs say the toast is dropped; the app must say reminders may not have shown, never that a dose was missed.

REM-WIN-04.title: Restart with scheduled toasts pending
REM-WIN-04.pass_criteria: Survival across restart is not established by the docs fetched; record it.

REM-WIN-05.title: Schedule edit, time-zone change, and clock change
REM-WIN-05.pass_criteria: No stale or duplicate toasts after reconcile.

REM-WIN-06.title: Notification settings and Focus: suppression is detected or documented
